The '''ARC-40b Scout-Reconnaissance Fighter''' was a medium escort fighter for [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170s]]. It carried a crew of three. Most were destroyed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], or were scrapped by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], although many still served in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in mercenary units or with surveyors during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="SaS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ARC-40b Scout-Reconnaissance Fighter is mentioned in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2016]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Savage Spirits]]''.
